ei.title: The Impact of Light on Health
ei.subject: 공통영어1

fullPassage:
The Impact of Light on Health

Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.

However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light.

In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night. This improves people's cognitive abilities and overall mental health.

questions.passage: The Impact of Light on Health Sunlight offers (A)[numerous / scarce] health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the (B)[restraint / release] of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce (C)[satisfaction / depression] and anxiety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛은 수많은 건강상의 이점을 제공한다. 자연광은 세로토닌의 방출을 유발한다. 우울증과 불안을 줄여준다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① scarce — restraint — satisfaction
✅ ② numerous — release — depression ←정답
❌ ③ scarce — release — depression
❌ ④ numerous — restraint — satisfaction
(A) numerous(수많은): 건강상의 이점이 많다는 맥락. scarce(부족한)는 반대.
(B) release(방출): 세로토닌의 방출. restraint(억제)는 반대.
(C) depression(우울증): reduce depression. satisfaction(만족)은 줄일 대상이 아님.
det.tip: numerous = 수많은. release = 방출, 분비. depression = 우울증.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light (A)[exhaust / energize] us, but they can also (B)[disturb / enhance] sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most (C)[sensitivity / resistance] to blue light.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 파란색과 흰색 빛은 우리에게 활력을 준다. 수면 패턴을 방해할 수 있다. 뇌는 파란 빛에 가장 민감하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① exhaust — enhance — resistance
❌ ② exhaust — disturb — resistance
❌ ③ energize — enhance — sensitivity
✅ ④ energize — disturb — sensitivity ←정답
(A) energize(활력을 주다): 원문 그대로. exhaust(지치게 하다)는 반대.
(B) disturb(방해하다): 수면 패턴을 방해. enhance(향상시키다)는 반대.
(C) sensitivity(민감성): 뇌가 파란 빛에 민감. resistance(저항)는 반대.
det.tip: energize = 활력을 주다. disturb = 방해하다. sensitivity = 민감성.

In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety. On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders. However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light. In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can (B)[improve / worsen] mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: impact — improve — cognitive
det.analysis:
❌ ① stimulate — improve — cognitive
✅ ② impact — improve — cognitive ←정답
❌ ③ impact — worsen — cognitive
❌ ④ impact — improve — physical
(A) impact(영향을 미치다): least likely to impact. stimulate(자극하다)는 의미 다름.
(B) improve(개선하다): 정신 건강을 개선. worsen(악화시키다)은 반대.
(C) cognitive(인지적): cognitive abilities. physical(신체적)은 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: impact = 영향을 미치다. cognitive = 인지의. improve = 개선하다.

questions.passage:
The Impact of Light on Health

Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it ①<u>boosts</u> vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, ②<u>promotes</u> diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also ③<u>affects</u> mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to ④<u>promote</u> happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 소량의 햇빛은 비타민 D 수치를 높이고 뼈를 강하게 한다. 질병을 예방하고 피부 질환을 치유한다. 정신 건강에도 영향을 미친다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① boosts(높이다): 비타민 D 수치를 높인다. 원문 그대로.
❌ ② promotes(촉진하다): 원문은 prevents(예방하다). 질병을 촉진한다는 맥락 반대. ←정답
✅ ③ affects(영향을 미치다): 정신 건강에 영향. 원문 그대로.
✅ ④ promote(촉진하다): 행복을 촉진한다. 원문 그대로.
det.tip: prevents(예방하다) ↔ promotes(촉진하다). prevent diseases = 질병을 예방하다.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light ①<u>extends</u> beyond sunlight. Colors created by ②<u>artificial</u> light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by ③<u>lowering</u> levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that ④<u>disrupts</u> night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 빛의 영향은 햇빛 너머로 확장된다. 인공 빛에 의해 만들어진 색상. 멜라토닌 수치를 낮추어. 밤낮 주기와 수면-각성 주기를 조절하는 화학물질.
det.analysis:
✅ ① extends(확장되다): 원문 그대로.
✅ ② artificial(인공의): 원문 그대로.
✅ ③ lowering(낮추는): 원문 그대로.
❌ ④ disrupts(방해하다): 원문은 regulates(조절하다). 멜라토닌이 주기를 방해한다는 것은 맥락 반대. ←정답
det.tip: regulates(조절하다) ↔ disrupts(방해하다). melatonin regulates sleep cycles.

questions.passage:
On the other hand, ①<u>reductions</u> in sunlight are ②<u>linked</u> to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders. 

However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light. 

In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can ③<u>diminish</u> mental health by ④<u>increasing</u> the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛의 감소는 공황 발작과 관련이 있다. 저녁에 빨간 빛에 노출되면 정신 건강을 개선할 수 있다. 멜라토닌 분비를 증가시켜.
det.analysis:
✅ ① reductions(감소): 원문 그대로.
✅ ② linked(연결된): 원문 그대로.
❌ ③ diminish(감소시키다): 원문은 improve(개선하다). 정신 건강을 감소시킨다는 맥락 반대. ←정답
✅ ④ increasing(증가시키는): 원문 그대로.
det.tip: improve(개선하다) ↔ diminish(감소시키다).

questions.passage:
The Impact of Light on Health

Sunlight offers numerous health __________. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and heals skin conditions. Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to promote happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 햇빛은 수많은 건강상의 ____을 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① benefits(이점) ←정답: 이후 비타민 D, 뼈 강화, 질병 예방 등 긍정적 효과 나열.
❌ ② conditions(상태): health conditions는 질환 의미.
❌ ③ patterns(패턴): 맥락 부적합.
❌ ④ disorders(장애): 부정적 의미로 부적합.
det.tip: health benefits = 건강상의 이점.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different __________ and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: emotions
det.analysis:
✅ ① emotions(감정) ←정답: 색상이 다양한 감정을 유발한다는 맥락.
❌ ② effects(효과): have other effects와 중복되어 어색.
❌ ③ cycles(주기): 색상이 주기를 유발한다는 것은 부자연스러움.
❌ ④ levels(수치): 색상이 수치를 유발한다는 것은 부자연스러움.
det.tip: emotions = 감정. Colors can cause different emotions.

questions.passage:
Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of __________, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles. The brain has the most sensitivity to blue light. 

In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 저녁에 빨간 빛에 노출되면 ____의 분비를 증가시켜 밤에 더 나은 수면으로 이끈다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① serotonin(세로토닌): 세로토닌은 자연광/햇빛과 관련.
❌ ② adrenaline(아드레날린): 본문에 언급 없음.
✅ ③ melatonin(멜라토닌) ←정답
❌ ④ dopamine(도파민): 본문에 언급 없음.: 빨간 빛이 멜라토닌 분비 증가 → 수면 개선.
det.tip: melatonin = 수면 조절 호르몬. red light → melatonin ↑ → better sleep.

questions.passage:

Sunlight offers numerous health benefits. In small amounts, it boosts vitamin D levels, makes the bones stronger, prevents diseases, and <u>heals</u> skin conditions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 heals와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 피부 질환을 치유한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① cures(치료하다) ←정답: heals = 치유하다 ≈ cures.
❌ ② harms(해치다): 반대 의미.
❌ ③ hides(숨기다): 의미 다름.
❌ ④ spreads(퍼뜨리다): 의미 다름.
det.tip: heals = 치유하다 = cures.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by <u>artificial</u> light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also disturb sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 artificial와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 인공 빛에 의해 만들어진 색상.
det.analysis:
❌ ① natural(자연의): 반의어.
❌ ② genuine(진짜의): 반의어 성격.
✅ ③ synthetic(인공의) ←정답: artificial = 인공의 ≈ synthetic.
❌ ④ original(원래의): 의미 다름.
det.tip: artificial = 인공의, 합성의 = synthetic.

questions.passage: However, the impact of light extends beyond sunlight. Colors created by artificial light can cause different emotions and have other effects on the body. Blue and white light energize us, but they can also <u>disturb</u> sleep patterns by lowering levels of melatonin, a chemical made in the brain that regulates night-and-day cycles and sleep-wake cycles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 disturb와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 수면 패턴을 방해하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① maintain(유지하다): 반대.
❌ ② establish(확립하다): 의미 다름.
❌ ③ restore(회복하다): 반대.
✅ ④ disrupt(방해하다) ←정답: disturb ≈ disrupt.
det.tip: disturb = 방해하다 = disrupt.

questions.passage: Sunlight also affects mental health. Natural light causes the release of serotonin, a natural chemical the brain produces to <u>promote</u> happiness and pleasure and reduce depression and anxiety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 promote와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 행복과 즐거움을 촉진하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① suppress(억제하다) ←정답: promote(촉진하다)의 반의어.
❌ ② encourage(격려하다): 유의어.
❌ ③ foster(육성하다): 유의어.
❌ ④ advance(진전시키다): 유의어.
det.tip: promote(촉진하다) ↔ suppress(억제하다).

questions.passage:
On the other hand, reductions in sunlight are linked to panic attacks and anxiety-related disorders.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 beyond와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 빛의 영향은 햇빛 너머로 확장된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① outside(바깥에): 유사한 방향성.
❌ ② above(위에): 의미 차이.
✅ ③ within(~이내에) ←정답: beyond(~너머로)의 반의어.
❌ ④ across(가로질러): 의미 차이.
det.tip: beyond(~너머로) ↔ within(~이내에).

questions.passage:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 light의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은? (A) The room was filled with natural light from the large windows. (B) She packed only light clothing for the summer trip.

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 가벼운 (B) 빛: 의미 뒤바뀜.
❌ ② (A) 밝은 (B) 적은: 부적합.
❌ ③ (A) 적은 (B) 밝은: 부적합.
✅ ④ (A) 빛 (B) 가벼운 ←정답
det.tip: light: (명사) 빛 / (형용사) 가벼운.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a natural substance produced by the brain that controls body functions such as sleep"

❌ ① symptom(증상): 물질이 아님.

❌ ③ therapy(치료): 물질이 아님.
❌ ④ organ(기관): 물질이 아님.
det.tip: chemical = 화학물질. a natural chemical the brain produces.

In contrast, red and yellow light are the least likely to impact our bodies. Exposure to red light in the evening can improve mental health by increasing the release of melatonin, which leads to better sleep at night.
